scenario: Cost optimisation with a 90% equity floor
baseline: Baseline — network as it operates today

steps.title: Adopt a 90% minimum fill rate for every vulnerability quintile
steps.detail: Make the equity floor an explicit planning standard rather than an outcome. It becomes a constraint on every subsequent network decision and a reportable indicator.
steps.risk: Costs more than the unconstrained optimum. That is the point: it is the price of not funding the saving out of the hardest-to-reach quintile.
steps.evidence: Worst-quintile fill rate moves from 100% to 90%.
